title: linearPattern
body:
## linearPattern

Repeat one additive or subtractive sketch feature along a Body origin X/Y/Z axis while continuing the current tip. count includes the original; length is the total first-to-last distance in mm, so pitch is length/(count-1). The selected original remains a native feature and the result remains one solid. General multitransforms, arbitrary datum pattern axes and whole-Body copying are not provided here.

Native binding: `PartDesign::LinearPattern`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base` | one node | yes | `solid` |
| `feature` | one node | yes | `solid` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `length` | Positive total first-to-last pattern span in mm, default 20. With count instances the equal pitch is length/(count-1); count includes the original. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | `20` |
| `count` | Number of feature occurrences including the original, from2 to100. A pattern does not implicitly duplicate the entire Body; choose the original material-changing feature explicitly. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":2,"maximum":100}` | `2` |
| `direction` | The Body origin X/Y/Z axis along which the pattern advances, default X. | `{"type":"enum","values":["X","Y","Z"]}` | `"X"` |
